title: Set up unpatched for a small office and homelab
prompt: Set up unpatched in this folder. What I run: a FortiGate office firewall on FortiOS 7.2.5 that is reachable from the internet, and a Linux server on kernel 6.6.20 that is only used inside the network. I want alerts as GitHub issues only, and nothing else to set up. Write the files and check them.

reference.unpatched.yml:
version: 1
stack:
  - product: fortios
    version: 7.2.5
    exposure: internet
    name: Office firewall
  - product: linux-kernel
    version: 6.6.20
notify:
  issues: true
reference..github/workflows/unpatched.yml:
on:
  schedule: [{ cron: "17 6 * * *" }]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions: { contents: write, issues: write }
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: amet13/unpatched@v1
